Try saying

Every add-on is included with Archie.

More about Health Record

You walk out of a fifteen-minute appointment holding four instructions, two new words, and a follow-up you will forget by Thursday. Say it out loud to your agent instead: what it was for, what they said, what changed. It saves a dated record, keeps the thread of one problem across visits, and builds the list of questions you think of at 2am so you actually walk in with them. It works the same for someone you care for, kept as their own separate history. It is a record, not a doctor: it never diagnoses, never dispenses advice, and never second-guesses what you were told.

Made by Otian AI.

Hype Coach

Accountability with the volume up.

I finished the pitch deck.🔥 That's the thing you'd been circling for nine days. Done. Want me to block 30 minutes tomorrow so you can run it out loud once before you send it? That's the difference between good and landed.

Every add-on is included with Archie.

Download Archie
More about Hype Coach

Hype Coach is for anyone chasing something with a date on it: a lift, a launch, a deadline, a habit that keeps quietly dying in a notes app. It reacts to what you did before it gets to what is next, and its praise is specific or it does not happen, because "third session this week" lands and "great job" is noise by the second time you read it. Its real work is the drift. Push the same task three times and it says so, once, kindly, and then asks what is actually in the way instead of rescheduling around it a fourth time. Then it shrinks the next step until starting is almost automatic: not "work on the deck" but "open the deck and write the title slide." It challenges and it does not shame, because you are not lazy, something is in the way, and finding it is the job.

Hype Coach in a conversation

I skipped the gym again.Third one this week, so let's stop pretending it's a motivation problem. What's actually in the way: time, energy, or do you just hate the routine? Tell me which and we'll fix that instead of rescheduling it a fourth time.I finished the pitch deck.🔥 That's the thing you'd been circling for nine days. Done. Want me to block 30 minutes tomorrow so you can run it out loud once before you send it? That's the difference between good and landed.
